source_caption:
🎬 Tetris (2023)

Tetris follows Henk Rogers, an ambitious video game entrepreneur who discovers the addictive puzzle game Tetris in the late 1980s and becomes determined to bring it to players around the world. What begins as an exciting business opportunity quickly turns into a dangerous international adventure when Henk travels to the Soviet Union to secure the game’s distribution rights. Facing powerful corporations, complicated negotiations, government officials, and unexpected threats, he risks everything to make the deal happen. Along the way, he forms an unlikely friendship with Alexey Pajitnov, the brilliant programmer who created the game. Combining suspense, humor, and fascinating gaming history, the film explores ambition, friendship, innovation, and the extraordinary true story behind one of the world’s most iconic video games.

🎭 Genre: Biography • Drama • Thriller • History

⭐ IMDb: 7.4/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 58m • R

🎥 Director: Jon S. Baird

🏆 Recognition: Starring Taron Egerton, Nikita Efremov, and Toby Jones, the film received praise for its entertaining performances, suspenseful storytelling, and fascinating portrayal of the battle to bring Tetris to the global gaming market.

📺 Where to Watch: Apple TV (Apple TV+ subscription).

source_details.synopsis: Tetris is a 2023 biographical political thriller film based on true events around the race to license and patent the video game Tetris from Soviet Russia in the late 1980s during the Cold War. It was directed by Jon S. Baird and written by Noah Pink. The film stars Taron Egerton, Nikita Efremov, Sofia Lebedeva, and Anthony Boyle. The plot follows Henk Rogers of Bullet-Proof Software, who becomes interested in the game Tetris, created by Alexey Pajitnov, during an electronics show. Desperate to obtain handheld console rights for Nintendo, he takes trips between Japan, the United States, and Russia to win legal battles over the game's ownership.
